title: Database Connection Failure on checkout-db
description: checkout-service cannot acquire a connection from the primary database (checkout-db) and customers see 'unable to complete order'. Connection acquisition attempts time out and the connection pool saturates at 100% under sustained checkout load.
raw_logs: ERROR [checkout-db-pool] connection acquisition wait time p95=29000ms approaching timeout 30000ms
ERROR com.ecommerce.checkout.CheckoutService - Timed out waiting for database connection pool 'HikariPool-1' after 30000ms
ERROR [checkout-db-pool] active=50 idle=0 waiting=34 utilization=100% threads_blocked=34

raw_events.description: Rolled out checkout-service v2.4.1 (raised default query timeout)
Checkout request rate 4x above 7-day baseline (flash sale campaign)
